typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		CONTACT_ID as string,
		MAG_INDIV_ID as string,
		DIGITAL_ID as string,
		FILE_NAME as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: false,
	validateSchema: true,
	ignoreNoFilesFound: false,
	wildcardPaths:['raw/ib_client_agility_data_*']) ~> source1
ConditionalSplit1@toUpsert select(mapColumn(
		ADFId__c,
		Id = CONTACT_ID,
		Customer_Id__c = MAG_INDIV_ID,
		Digital_ID__c = DIGITAL_ID
	),
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> Select1
source1 derive(ADFId__c = uuid()) ~> addADFId
addADFId split(isNull(CONTACT_ID) || (isNull(DIGITAL_ID) && isNull(MAG_INDIV_ID)),
	disjoint: false) ~> ConditionalSplit1@(toReject, toUpsert)
rejectReason select(mapColumn(
		ADFId__c,
		REJECT_REASON
	),
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> Select2
ConditionalSplit1@toReject derive(REJECT_REASON = concat('ADF:Required Field Contains NULL Value: ', iif(isNull(CONTACT_ID), 'CONTACT_ID ', ''), iif(isNull(DIGITAL_ID) && isNull(MAG_INDIV_ID), 'MAG_INDIV_ID AND Digital ID', ''))) ~> rejectReason
Select1 sink(allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	partitionFileNames:['ib_client_agility_data_Contact.csv'],
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> Upsert
addADFId sink(allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	partitionFileNames:['ib_client_agility_data_raw.csv'],
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> curatedInbound
Select2 sink(allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	partitionFileNames:['ib_client_agility_data_source_reject.csv'],
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> Reject
